why: rc9 CI: a wrapped long text left its short tail line outside the duplicate guard; the guard now works on the whole text

ops.old:
for _, ln in ipairs(T.Lines(text, wrap, size, mode)) do
        if #ln < 14 or not seen[ln] then
            seen[ln] = true
            tt:AddLine(ln, color[1], color[2], color[3], mode ~= 3)
            style(tt, "Left")
        end
    end
ops.new:
if #text >= 14 then
        if seen[text] then
            return
        end
        seen[text] = true
    end
    for _, ln in ipairs(T.Lines(text, wrap, size, mode)) do
        tt:AddLine(ln, color[1], color[2], color[3], mode ~= 3)
        style(tt, "Left")
    end
